title: Negotiation Practice: Coffee Supply Deal
brief: You own a small café in Doha. You need **{monthly_kg} kg** of roasted coffee beans per month for **{months} months**. Your target is **QAR {budget} per kg** or less. You're meeting Yousef from Al Waha Coffee Traders. Get the best deal you can.
tips: Think about your opening offer, what you can offer in return, and what you'd do if this deal fails.
opening_line: Welcome! I'm Yousef from Al Waha Coffee Traders. I hear you're looking for a regular supply of beans for your café. Tell me what you need.
end_help: Click once you've agreed a deal, or if you want to walk away.
turn_limit_reached: You've reached the message limit for this session. End the negotiation to get your feedback.
message_too_long: That message is too long. Please keep it under {n} characters.
model_error: The AI is busy or unreachable right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
left_on_table_help: Difference between your deal and the best price the supplier would have accepted.
hidden_reveal: List price was QAR {list}/kg. On 30-day payment he could go to QAR {floor_std}/kg. His company had a cash-flow problem, so with payment within 7 days he could go to QAR {floor_best}/kg. He also had surplus Colombian beans to move.
session_cost_help: Estimated at paid API rates. Logged per call for budget planning.
insights_intro: Anonymous usage data: no student messages are stored, only counts, scores and costs.
no_data: No data yet. Complete a negotiation first.
supplier_role: Sales Manager, Al Waha Coffee Traders
voice_help: Turn off for a quiet room. Everything he says is also shown as text.
voice_tip: Type, or press the microphone in the message box to speak.
couldnt_hear: Sorry, I couldn't make out that recording. Try again a little closer to the microphone, or type your message.
recording_too_long: That recording is too long. Please keep it under two minutes.
voice_unavailable: Voice isn't available right now, so Yousef will reply in text.
